🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “Rodri benched? He played a lot of minutes with the national team, and I told him this morning that I made the decision to start BERNAL. It was a good solution. At the end, Rodri is fresh for Sunday Clàsico.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Hansi Flick: “To see Xavi Espart playing at SUCH A LEVEL is incredible. It looks like he has been in the first team for 3 or 4 seasons. How he defended, how he attacked... I am very happy with him.” #fcblive

🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “We can take a lot of positives from this performance, but we still have work to do. They’ve been the team to beat for the last two years, and we need to learn from this game and aim to become that team ourselves. The good thing is that this was a league-stage match, not a final, so we could get another chance to beat them in a later round.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Anthony Gordon: “I don't think I was good tonight, like the whole team. I think we want to perform better. I know I was NOT at my best.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Desire Doue: “When you beat one of the biggest teams in Europe, you're extremely happy. So yes, we're extremely happy tonight.” #fcblive
🚨🎙️| Luis Enrique: “Today we opposed one of the best teams in the world and I think both teams deserved to win.” #fcblive 🤝
